items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: And it terminated by saying, sung by Billy Jones and Ada Murray.

ctx.x: Put it with the fingers in it. And they had all kinds of records. They didn't simply lean to the classics. They also included ragtime. And they had the face phonograph, the little cylinder ones that I just wish to the Lord I had now. I can remember some of the songs they sang. And one of them was, The Iceman is a nice man, but just one thing is sure. There's something in his business that affects his temperature. Oh, love is such a funny thing, just a fondle once or twice. But all you get from the Iceman is ice,…
I like that song on there.
